Subject: TempoHealth POC wrap: results summary + quick quote/call request

Hi Jordan —

Really appreciate TempoHealth partnering with us for the two-week POC. Quick summary of the top-line outcomes we tracked end-to-end against the initial success criteria: 

- Latency (tail p95) for the clinical triage model: 430ms → 160ms (63% reduction)
- Cost per inference (token-level accounting, inclusive of batching): $0.018 → $0.009 (48% lower)
- Throughput (requests / minute): baseline 120 → 360 (3x) while staying within 25ms jitter target
- Production-like reliability: sustained >99.9% availability across the test window

Attached are the raw metrics export (tempo_poc_metrics.csv) and a two-slide summary we’d like to share with your team and our marketing team (redwood_poc_slide.pdf).

Small favor — would TempoHealth be open to: 
1) A two-line quote we can use in a short case blurb (we’ll share the draft for approval).
2) A 15-minute call (recording optional) to capture a quick soundbite and confirm attribution.

If yes, suggested times (PT): Thu 10/7 9:00–11:00am, Thu 10/7 3:00–4:00pm, or Fri 10/8 10:00–11:30am. You can also pick a slot on my calendar: https://calendar.redwood.ai/s/kimberly/15min

Thanks again — the results look strong and we’d love to highlight TempoHealth’s efficiency gains.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
